user.title: Allegro
user.description: Sign in with Browser Companion (Chromium in the sidebar), or paste QXLSESSID.

cookie.title: Allegro
cookie.description: Go to {allegro_url} and get the QXLSESSID cookie using browser dev tools (F12).

companion.title: Browser Companion
companion.description:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Sign in on allegro.pl, then go to {orders_url}. QXLSESSID is captured on that page.

companion_failed.title: Browser Companion
companion_failed.description:
Could not sign in with Browser Companion. Start the add-on, then submit to try again. You can also cancel and paste QXLSESSID instead.

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

abort.companion_unavailable: Browser Companion did not capture the login. Try again or paste QXLSESSID.

progress.companion_wait:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Sign in, then open {orders_url}. This screen updates when QXLSESSID is captured.

add_to_cart_failed.message: Could not add offer {item_id} to the cart: {error}

multiple_accounts.message: Multiple Allegro accounts are configured. Select an account.

add_to_cart.name: Add to cart
add_to_cart.description: Add an Allegro offer to the shopping cart.

item_id.name: Offer ID
item_id.description: Allegro offerId from the offer URL query parameter, for example 15070058532.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Allegro account to use when more than one is configured.
